starting_point: Phase 5C official DLRS catalogue records and public previews; no catalogue rediscovery performed.

digital_mouza_map.provider: Digital Mouza Map / Mouza BD; private secondary repository, not DLRS or Ministry of Land

matching_catalogue_entries.title: Sujatpur Mouza Map — মনিরামপুর, যশোর (BS/RS survey, JL 143, Sheet 1)
observations: A third-party catalogue record exists for a putative J.L. 143 sheet, but its listed BS/RS edition is not an exact match for the four official CS/RS catalogue records.
The publicly served product image is a preview thumbnail, not a full-resolution downloadable map file.
Visual comparison did not establish a content match to any of the four DLRS previews; sheet title/J.L./sheet identity is not independently legible and the visible map layout differs.
The preview title block text refers to the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act and a 1958–65 period; this does not independently establish its survey edition or identity.

The product detail page displayed BDT 80 and a one-time payment/checkout statement. No checkout or download was attempted. The broader site's free-download statements conflict with this specific page's payment prompt; access terms for this item remain unresolved.
matching_catalogue_entries.license: No item-specific reuse license was identified. Repository describes itself as private and says files are reference copies, not certified copies; retained preview only for internal provenance review.

exact_sheet_outcomes.RS_sheet_1: not_found_as_an_exact_matching_secondary_record; one unverified BS/RS sheet-1 listing exists

digital_mouza_map.search_notes: Location-filtered Digital Mouza Map search returned one matching Manirampur/Sujatpur/J.L.143 listing, BS/RS sheet 1. Search results for Sujatpur also returned homonymous mouzas in other districts; those were excluded.

mowjabd.provider: MowjaBD; third-party public-data interface, not an official DLRMS service
mowjabd.results: The public embedded Google Drive folder returned HTTP 404. The site's own read-only /api/drive/library root request returned a serverless FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED response. No Sujatpur item or map file was accessible to inspect.

ministry_map_portal.provider: Ministry of Land, Bangladesh, Mouza and Plot Based National Digital Land Zoning project

public_live_query.method: Read-only POST to public location lookup endpoint using site session and CSRF token; no user data or account credentials sent

ministry_map_portal.interpretation: The public page has administrative selectors and describes georeferenced mouza/plot maps, but the live Khulna division response did not include Jashore. The target record could not be selected, rendered or downloaded. Selector presence is not evidence of target access.

map_comparison.method: Human visual comparison of third-party listing thumbnail against all four existing low-resolution DLRS catalogue previews; no georeferencing or image registration performed.
map_comparison.result: No content match confirmed. All map-source identities remain not_verified beyond the official catalogue metadata.
